name: sharpshot-studio
description: Fast native Windows capture with a focused Electron workflow and editing studio.
author: Leonxlnx

scripts.package:dir: npm run native:vendor && npm run media:verify && npm run build && npm run native:verify && electron-builder --dir && npm run native:verify && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-packaged-ffmpeg.ps1 -PackagePath ../artifacts/desktop/win-unpacked
scripts.package:zip: npm run native:vendor && npm run media:verify && npm run build && npm run native:verify && electron-builder --win zip && npm run native:verify && npm run media:verify-package
scripts.package:win: npm run native:vendor && npm run media:verify && npm run build && npm run native:verify && electron-builder --win nsis zip && npm run native:verify && npm run media:verify-package && npm run setup:verify
